name: security-sop
description: Field procedures for a fictional security integrator: customer footage requests and site credentials.
guardrails: Answer only from the knowledge base.
Cite document and section for every slide and question.
If not covered, say it is not covered.
Never tell a technician to release footage without the approvals the SOP requires.

audience.notes: hands-on, needs the exact procedure steps

glossary.definition: Any request, from anyone, for a copy of recorded video from a customer site.
The person asking for footage. They must be verified before any work starts.
A person named on the customer's site record who may approve footage releases.
Copying recorded video out of the recorder into a file for release.
The record of every person who handled an export, and when.
Any username, password, PIN, or key card that grants access to customer equipment.

starterPrompts: Build a short training on handling a customer footage request
Build a short training on handling site credentials
Build a short training on drone patrol procedures
